title: Mindanao towns differ on Teachers’ Day class suspension

blocks.text: VALENCIA CITY, Bukidnon — Several Mindanao towns differed on whether to suspend or hold classes for World Teachers’ Day on Monday. In Talakag, Bukidnon, Mayor Renato Sulatan stood firm in his decision to suspend classes in the municipality for World Teachers’ Day on Monday, making it the only municipality in the province to do so.
